   2. Apply the configuration and verify with `echo status`
   3. Enable persistence across reboots if applicable

2. Tool Selection & Logic:
   Primary tool: `echo` — echo command execution and management
   Supporting tool: `systemctl` — manage systemd services and units

    Require all granted
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/public-dav.conf && sudo a2ensite public-dav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2
